items.title: Conventions for Using SI Units (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Conventions for Using SI Units: a main subheading of 1.2 International System of Units, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 5-8.

blocks.text: SI units likhte waqt, khas taur par prefixes likhte waqt, care (ehtiyat) chahiye. Yeh points yaad rakhein:

items: Har SI unit ka ek symbol hai, abbreviation (lafz ka chhota roop) nahi; symbols har language mein ek jaise hain, is liye sahi symbol likhna zaroori hai. Misal: ampere ke liye “A”, “amp” nahi; second ke liye “s”, “sec” nahi; SI, S.I. nahi.
Unit ka poora naam capital letter se shuru nahi hota: newton, metre waghaira; sirf Celsius is se alag hai.
Symbols lower case (chhote letters) mein hote hain: metre ke liye “m”, second ke liye “s”; litre ka “L” alag hai.
Jo units scientists ke naam par hain un ke symbol ka pehla letter capital hota hai: newton ke liye “N”, pascal ke liye “Pa”, watt ke liye “W”.
Symbols aur prefixes hamesha upright (seedhe, roman) style mein chhapte hain, chahe aas paas ka text italic (tircha) ho. Misal: a distance of 50 m.
Symbols ka plural (ek se zyada wala roop) nahi banta: 1 mm, 100 mm, 1 kg, 60 kg (kgs nahi).
Symbol ke baad full stop ya dot nahi lagta, siwaye jumle ke aakhir ke.
Prefix unit se pehle aur baghair space ke likha jata hai: “mL”, m L nahi; “ms”, m s nahi.
Units ke darmiyan ek space chhorein, aur number (value) aur symbol ke darmiyan bhi space chhorein: 1 kg, 10 m s⁻¹.

blocks.text: Mass ko energy ki ek shakal samjha ja sakta hai; dar asal mass bohat concentrated (ek jagah jama, ghani) energy hai. Einstein ki famous equation E = mc² ka matlab hai: energy = mass × (roshni ki speed)². Is equation ke mutabiq 1 kg mass asal mein 9 × 10¹⁶ J energy ke barabar hai.
blocks.title: Do You Know? (Kya aap jante hain?)

items: Do prefix ek saath (compound prefix) nahi lagte: 1 µµF ko 1 pF likhein.
Jab prefix wale unit par power lagti hai to power poore multiple par lagti hai, sirf base unit par nahi: 1 km² = 1 (km)² = 1 × (10³ m)² = 1 × 10⁶ m².
Solidus (m/s) ki jagah negative index (m s⁻¹) likhein.
Scientific notation istemal karein, yani decimal ke baen ek non-zero digit: 143.7 = 1.437 × 10².
Ek hi expression mein symbol aur naam mila kar na likhein: metre per second ya m s⁻¹ likhein; metre/sec ya m/second nahi.
Practical ki readings us unit mein likhein jo instrument ke liye convenient (aasan) ho: screw gauge ki readings mm mein, magar final result sahi base units mein.
SI purane CGS system ke units, jaise dyne, erg, gauss, poise, torr (kitab mein “Tor”), ki ijazat nahi deta.

blocks.text: 1 kg × (3 × 10⁸ m s⁻¹)² = 9 × 10¹⁶ J. Isi liye nuclear reactions mein thora sa mass kam hone par bohat zyada energy nikalti hai.
blocks.title: Easy words mein

blocks.prompt: 0.000 000 52 m aur 4 500 000 J ko scientific notation mein sahi prefix ke saath likhein, aur 'a force of 20 Newtons', '5 kgs', '12 m/s' aur '1 mmm' ko rules ke mutabiq sahi karein.
blocks.explanation: 0.000 000 52 m = 5.2 × 10⁻⁷ m = 0.52 µm (ya 520 nm); 4 500 000 J = 4.5 × 10⁶ J = 4.5 MJ. Unit ka naam chhote harf se aur symbol N: '20 N' ya '20 newton'. Symbol ka plural nahi: '5 kg'. Solidus ki jagah negative index: '12 m s⁻¹'. Compound prefix ki ijazat nahi: 1 mmm (milli-milli-metre) = 1 µm.

items: SI (1960): saat base units (m, kg, s, A, K, cd, mol) aur derived units (rad, sr, N, J, W, C, Pa waghaira); kuch additional (izafi) units ki bhi ijazat (degree, minute, hour, litre, tonne, u, eV, bar waghaira).
Scientific notation: decimal se pehle sirf ek non-zero digit (1.347 × 10²). Prefixes atto (10⁻¹⁸) se exa (10¹⁸) tak, zyada tar 1000 ke steps mein; saath centi, deci, deka, hecto.

16 rules: symbol, abbreviation nahi; chhote harf, siwaye scientists ke naam aur L ke; koi plural ya full stop nahi; prefix jura hua; adad aur unit ke darmiyan space; compound prefix nahi; power poore multiple par; m s⁻¹, m/s nahi; naam aur symbol mila kar nahi; CGS units nahi.
